name: OpenClaw Enterprise
desc: Vendor-neutral platform for running persistent agents in sensitive environments.
desc_zh: 在敏感环境里运行常驻智能体的开源平台。
solves: Security teams block agents outright because they cannot see or bound what one does; this gives them a platform they can audit and deploy themselves.
solves_zh: 安全团队因为看不清也框不住智能体的行为就一律禁用；这个平台让他们能审计并自己部署。
best_for: Your security review is the reason the agent pilot never left the sandbox.
best_for_zh: 安全评审就是你的智能体试点没能走出沙箱的原因。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — openclaw.ai/blog）。 Post byline: Kevin Lin, Sep 29, 2026. Abbreviated OCE in the post. A separate deployment surface from the OpenClaw runtime the ledger holds; Microsoft Autopilot is built on OpenClaw per the Sep 25, 2026 post. 首次公开日期来源：https://openclaw.ai/blog/openclaw-enterprise
